bugs.description: Bot told user '11:00 ya no está disponible' — this was the first time Carmen requested 11am; the slot was never held. Bot fabricated a 'moved slot' context that never existed. In Turn 7 the bot repeats the same spurious 'se me ha movido el hueco de las 11:00' message even though Carmen had only just requested that slot in Turn 6.
Bot claimed 11:00 'ya no está disponible' without ever having offered or confirmed that slot to Carmen. The slot was never booked or reserved for her — it simply was not available.
Policy acceptance not persisted to DB. Customer record with policy_accepted_at was never created despite verbal acceptance in Turn 7. No customer row exists in DB after run.
